items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I had told Mr. Lunceford I had worked on it... Jimmie Lunceford say, 'Let's Keep Smiling. Ready for it, Teddy?'... Mr. Lunceford was a man like this. He never questioned your ability to do something... He says, 'Why not.' Teddy can play it,' you know.

Joe didn't even wait around. Joe had gone. Now when we get to Fort Wayne, Indiana coming into Chicago, Eddie Wilcox tells Jimmy -- says, "Why don't we keep (inaudible) -- Because they had played (inaudible) these numbers. This particular number here they hadn't played yet, because they figured that I didn't know this, you know. He says, "Why can't we play Let's Keep Smiling?"
